items.title: Jane Bunnett interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 25, 2024
items.q: And Jon Hendricks — did some shows with Jon Hendricks here.

ctx.x: Oh my God. What an incredible whacky time that was. And then we got to work with the great Hermeto Pascoal. Had a big concert here with him. And Jon Hendricks — did some shows with Jon Hendricks here. Of course Stanley Cowell, one of my heroes. Stanley Cowell, made a beautiful, beautiful record. And this was one of the most inspiring records for me, that was Don Pullen’s solo record. That was sort of in between — that was done in 1975. Wow. © Fillius Jazz Archive -17-
Well young musicians will be holding up your records and say, “I played with Jane.” So thank you for your time. This has been delightful.
